actions.reason: The K4_C0001-K4_C0004 boundary is the decision-relevant neighboring alternative for both sets (structural_pair_candidates). Its boundary_structure report shows the union is single-cluster-dominated (dominant eigengap candidate_k=1, 0.492), which is merge-compatible and must not be read as preserving the two-set boundary; the current-boundary ARI=1.0 with high normalized-cut cost (0.550) and markedly imbalanced side volumes indicates the two-way split is not independently supported. The boundary_representation report is materially conflicting: WXS shows moderate-to-strong separation (silhouette 0.315) while CT is negative (-0.027, 0.596 negative fraction) and RNA/WSI are only weakly positive, so the boundary is not consistently represented across modalities. Biologically the two sets share direction: both show oxidative-phosphorylation down-regulation (K4_C0001 NES -2.025; K4_C0004 NES -1.837) and both are VHL-enriched/PBRM1-depleted in the driver panel (K4_C0001 PBRM1 OR 20.37, VHL enriched; K4_C0004 VHL OR 12.55, PBRM1 OR 0.048), so the biological differences do not oppose union. The union is therefore more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained sets.

actions.reason: The merged set has an interpretable mutation phenotype (VHL/PBRM1 enrichment with BAP1 depletion), but its membership is broadly unsupported: native-geometry representation is weak and conflicting (CT silhouette -0.031, RNA 0.016, WSI 0.096, only WXS clearly positive 0.213), and the nearest competing label differs across modalities. Both decision-relevant boundaries are weak or merge-compatible: versus K4_C0002 the current boundary is only partially represented (ARI 0.648) with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1), and versus K4_C0003 the boundary is weakly represented (ARI 0.366) with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1). Membership also retains significant associations with tissue_source_site, ct_phase, and ct_manufacturer (all q=0.036), which remain plausible technical explanations for the current membership. With no supported split or merge alternative and no remaining evidence that could establish independence, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

K4_C0002 has a coherent metabolic/oxidative-phosphorylation transcriptomic phenotype, but its membership is largely unsupported: native geometry is weak-to-negative (CT 0.046, RNA -0.055, WSI -0.047, WXS -0.054) with the nearest competing label differing across modalities. Its boundary versus the merged set is only partially represented (ARI 0.648) with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1), and membership retains significant associations with tissue_source_site, ct_manufacturer, ct_scanner_model, ct_reconstruction_kernel, ct_slice_thickness, and ct_z_spacing (q 7.4e-05 to 0.0075), which remain plausible technical explanations. The one boundary with stronger structure (versus K4_C0003, ARI 0.846) is not sufficient to rescue a candidate whose own membership representation is broadly unsupported and whose other relevant boundary is merge-compatible.

K4_C0003 has a coherent immune/inflammatory transcriptomic phenotype, but its membership representation is weak and conflicting (RNA 0.133 and CT 0.056 positive, WSI -0.047 and WXS -0.007 non-separating) with the nearest competing label differing across modalities. Its boundary versus the merged set is weakly represented (ARI 0.366) with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1), and membership retains significant associations with tissue_source_site (q=0.009), ct_slice_thickness (q=0.034), and ct_z_spacing (q=0.0105), which remain plausible technical explanations. The stronger boundary versus K4_C0002 (ARI 0.846, candidate_k=2) does not by itself establish that K4_C0003 remains an independent unit given its broadly unsupported membership and merge-compatible boundary to the merged set.
